_comment: OPTIONAL daily override. An outside routine may overwrite this whole file to publish a verse of the day. It is shown ONLY if date equals today's date in Europe/Rome (YYYY-MM-DD) and verse, ref, it and en are all non-empty text; otherwise the site silently keeps the scheduled verse from daily.json. Example: {"date":"2026-11-05","verse":"Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita / mi ritrovai per una selva oscura","ref":"Inferno I, 1","it":"Riflessione.","en":"Reflection."}
